crew.overview: Unlucky assassin Ladybug is determined to do his job peacefully after one too many gigs gone off the rails. Fate, however, may have other plans, as Ladybug's latest mission puts him on a collision course with lethal adversaries from around the globe—all with connected, yet conflicting, objectives—on the world's fastest train.
crew.title: Bullet Train

details.biography: Rahma Farahat is a German-Saudi art director and production designer. She holds a BA in Cinematography from California State University, Long Beach, and an MFA in Production Design from Chapman University, Orange, California, USA.
details.name: Rahma Farahat
